_schema: summit_county/campaign_finance vision cache v1 — COVER-PAGE STATED TOTALS ONLY (no donor itemization)
_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.
method: vision via the Read tool on a pdftoppm -jpeg -r 200 render of page 1 cropped to the top 80% ($0 API; Claude Code allotment)
notes: Typed header, handwritten figures; re-read at 300dpi zoom. The Current contributions cell has an earlier figure struck out and '$5100—' written over it (dash for cents), same in Cumulative. The CUMULATIVE expenditure cell is genuinely ambiguous between $3733.22 and $3738.22 in the handwriting — left NULL rather than guessed; the Current cell reads $3733.22 clearly. Last Report cells hold a dash (recorded blank). Carries the clerk's printed instruction box.

_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: DELTA of 1,190.00. The 19 rows sum to 6,290.00; the cover states 5,100.00 (current_report and cumulative_totals both '$5100--', last_report blank). The amount column was re-read at 900-1500 dpi in slices and every figure was legible; the reading METHOD is independently validated on the same filer's Post-Election sheet 20766, where the three rows added after this report sum to exactly 200.00 = that cover's current-report contribution figure. The cover is internally consistent (5,100.00 - 3,733.22 = 1,366.78 = its stated balance), so the ledger simply lists more than the cover totals - the filer's arithmetic, published with both figures named.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of 1.58 against the page's own boxed total, which arithmetic resolves to 3,733.22 (see page_gates). Two amount cells stay genuinely doubtful at 1500 dpi and carry confidence=low: the 'LUNCH FOR CANVASSERS' row (26.90 vs 27.69, taken as 27.69) and the 'REG. TRUCK FOR SUMMIT.ORG' row (read '$72.--'; 22.80 and 72.28 were considered). A 1.58 correction inside those two cells would close the side exactly, but no reading of the glyphs produces it, so the delta is published rather than fitted. The SAME 22 rows produce the SAME 1.58 delta on the Post-Election filing 20766, which is a consistency check on the transcription rather than on the filer.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT (handwritten, county form, specimen row '8/25/10 Jon and Jane Doe / PO Box 128, Coalville, UT / 84017 / $435.00' dropped) prints no total of its own; the gate is the cover's 5,100.00, and the 19 rows sum to 6,290.00 - a delta of 1,190.00. p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT prints its OWN boxed total above the grid; the 22 rows sum to 3,734.80 against that box. THE BOXED FIGURE ITSELF WAS RESOLVED BY ARITHMETIC: its glyphs read '$3 7 3 8 . 7 1' and the module's cover cache records it as a genuine ILLEGIBLE, ambiguous between 3733.22 and 3738.22. The Post-Election filing 20766 reproduces the same box and then prints, in the filer's hand, '11/1/22 [box] + 1509.01 = 12/8/22 [5242.23]'. 3733.22 + 1509.01 = 5242.23 exactly; 3738.22 + 1509.01 = 5247.23, which is not the boxed cumulative. The box is therefore 3,733.22 and 3738.22 is EXCLUDED - gate 3, arithmetic outranks glyph reading, on a cell that had been carried as illegible since the 2026-08-02 cover tranche.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: John 'Jack' Murphy, County Council, 2022 Pre-Election. 3 pages: p1 cover, p2 handwritten contributions, p3 handwritten expenses, both on the county's 2022 form. THIS IS THE HARDEST HANDWRITING IN THE CHUNK - dense cursive, and the donor names in particular are only partly legible at 1200 dpi; every doubtful cell carries confidence=low and a note, and no name was invented. ADDRESSES: unlike the other 2022 filings in this chunk this sheet is NOT redacted - the Mailing Address and Zipcode columns are simply EMPTY for all 19 rows (the specimen row's address is intact and there is no erasure residue), so donor_city/donor_state are blank because THE FILER left them empty. A large hand-drawn ARROW runs down the empty Mailing Address column across the whole ledger - an annotation, not data. GEOMETRY: both pages' detected vertical rules start at an interior column (40.1% on p2, 74.3% on p3), so a measured box would clip the Date and Name columns; both sides therefore ship on force_declared frames that keep the pages' own measured band pitch (p2 y0=14.44 pitch=1.6879 from 40 detected bands; p3 y0=22.98 pitch=1.71 from 35) and widen x/w to the printed table. Band 1-2 on p2 and 1-2 on p3 are the header and the specimen row, so data rows are bands 3-21 (p2) and 3-24 (p3). Verified at 500-600 dpi: p2 band 3 -> '4/7/22 BOB C... $500--', p2 band 21 -> '8/8/22 DAWN CONDON $100--', p3 band 3 -> '3/9/22 SUMMIT COUNTY / CANDIDATE FEE / $303.02', p3 band 24 -> '3/2/22 STAPLES / CAMPAIGN REGISTRATION POSTAGE / $139.09'.
